pages.text: Magic metal will not heat in a common fire: put thaumium and void metal ingots in a $(item)nether alloy furnace$(), one at a time, and they come out glowing blue. Forge them into heads with the iron patterns and blueprints, polish, quench, and put on a stick.
Plates: one cold ingot each. Armour from plates: helmet 5, chestplate 8, leggings 7, boots 4, in the steel armour patterns. These replace Thaumaturge's crafting-table recipes.
